Accounting firm / fractional CFO Use the API to audit your clients' FX conversions at year-end and generate a standardized report with score and potential savings. Connect your data Three ways to send your transactions Pick the source that fits your stack. All converge into the same FX audit engine. CSV / PDF upload Available Global Import statements or receipts. Built-in OCR normalizes transactions automatically. REST API Available Global Send transactions directly via the API. Ideal for ERP, treasury, and platform integrations. Copilot Studio MCP Native Microsoft Connect iPayX FX Audit directly to Microsoft Copilot Studio via MCP. Universal bank coverage — any bank, any country iPayX accepts any bank statement in PDF or CSV, worldwide — no degraded experience for your prospects. Example request JSON request Copy { "api_client_id": "your_client_id", "transactions": [ { "id": "tx_001", "source_currency": "CAD", "target_currency": "USD", "source_amount": 100000, "target_amount": 71800, "trade_timestamp": "2026-04-15T14:30:00Z" } ] } Example response JSON response Copy { "bank_fx_score": 1, "partner_fx_score": "higher — reflects your configured partner rate", "score_basis": "bank_vs_partner", "scoring_profile": "default", "avg_markup_pct": 1.89, "transactions": [ { "id": "tx_001", "bank_fx_score": 1, "partner_fx_score": "higher — reflects your configured partner rate" } ] } Authentication Authenticate every request using your production API key in the Authorization header. Authorization: Bearer ipx_live_your_key Generate and manage your key in the Dashboard. Keys are server-side credentials and must never be exposed in client-side code. pages.title: FX Proof API — Sandbox Reference | iPayX
pages.text: FX Proof API — Sandbox Reference | iPayX iPayX Protocol Home FX Audit MCP Developers Pricing EN FR Log in Sign up EN FR Developers API Reference iPayX FX Proof API Audit FX transactions against the mid-market rate. Returns the hidden spread, true cost, and an FX score (1–10). Base URL https://api.ipayx.ai/v1 Authentication Authorization: Bearer ipx_live_… POST /audit Submit up to 50 FX transactions per request. The API fetches the mid-market rate at the time of each transaction, computes the spread and implicit cost, and returns an FX execution score for the batch. Headers Content-Type string required Must be application/json . Authorization string required Bearer ipx_live_… — generate keys from /developers while signed in. Request body JSON Copy { "language": "en", "transactions": [ { "id": "tx_001", "source_currency": "CAD", "target_currency": "USD", "source_amount": 10000, "target_amount": 7250, "date": "2026-04-18T15:32:00Z", "provider_name": "BigBank_CA" } ] } transactions array required Up to 50 transaction objects. Each object must include all fields below. transactions[].id string required Your internal transaction identifier. Echoed back in the response. transactions[].source_currency string required 3-letter ISO code (e.g. "CAD" ). transactions[].target_currency string required 3-letter ISO code (e.g. "USD" ). transactions[].source_amount number required Amount debited in source_currency . transactions[].target_amount number required Amount received in target_currency . transactions[].date ISO 8601 Execution timestamp. Optional. transactions[].provider_name string Free-text label for the provider/bank. Optional. language string "en" (default) or "fr" . Controls the AI commentary language. Response — 200 OK JSON Copy { "fx_score": 6, "score_rating": "fair", "avg_spread_pct": 1.823, "total_fx_cost": 132.02, "transactions_analyzed": 1, "transactions": [ { "id": "tx_001", "source_currency": "CAD", "target_currency": "USD", "source_amount": 10000, "target_amount": 7250, "mid_rate": 0.738523, "client_rate": 0.725, "spread_pct": 1.823, "fx_cost": -132.02, "commentary": "A 1.823% spread on a CAD/USD transaction is meaningfully above the typical mid-market reference. The implicit cost of ~132 CAD on a 10,000 notional reflects a non-competitive execution. Consider routing larger volumes through specialised FX providers." } ], "usage": { "plan": "starter", "audits_this_month": 1, "soft_limit": 1000, "over_limit": false } } fx_score number Execution score from 1 (critical) to 10 (excellent). score_rating string excellent | good | fair | poor | critical . avg_spread_pct number Average spread across all submitted transactions, in percent. total_fx_cost number Sum of absolute implicit costs across the batch, in source currency units. transactions array Per-transaction results: mid_rate , client_rate , spread_pct , fx_cost , and an AI commentary on the first item. usage object Current month usage: plan , audits_this_month , soft_limit , over_limit . Error — 401 Unauthorized JSON Copy { "error": "invalid_api_key", "message": "Missing or malformed Authorization header" } Error — 400 Validation JSON Copy { "error": "validation_error", "message": "Transaction tx_001 missing required fields (id, source_currency, target_currency, source_amount, target_amount)" } Error — 429 Rate Limit JSON Copy { "error": "rate_limit_exceeded", "message": "Too many requests. Try again later." } Rate limits are enforced per API key on a rolling 60-second window. The limit depends on your plan. cURL bash Copy curl -X POST https://api.ipayx.ai/v1/audit \ -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ -H "Authorization: Bearer ipx_live_YOUR_API_KEY" \ -d '{ "language": "en", "transactions": [ { "id": "tx_001", "source_currency": "CAD", "target_currency": "USD", "source_amount": 10000, "target_amount": 7250, "date": "2026-04-18T15:32:00Z", "provider_name": "BigBank_CA" } ] }' Notes Generate API keys from the /developers page once signed in. Keys start with ipx_live_ . Maximum 50 transactions per request. Submit additional batches if needed. Mid-market rates are fetched live from regulated interbank data providers. Soft monthly limits apply per plan: Starter 1,000 / Pro 10,000 / Enterprise unmetered. Above the soft limit, an X-Usage-Warning header is returned. Ready to integrate? Generate an API key in under a minute. pages.text: iPayX MCP Server — Documentation iPayX Protocol Home FX Audit MCP Developers Pricing EN FR Log in Sign up EN FR iPayX MCP Server — Documentation Connect your AI agent to real-time FX audit verdicts. 1. Endpoints Production MCP: https://hvujzsdwcoweirroubeh.supabase.co/functions/v1/mcp-server Documentation: https://hvujzsdwcoweirroubeh.supabase.co/functions/v1/mcp-server/docs 2. Available Tools audit_fx_transaction Free tier Score any FX transaction 1-10 with a qualitative verdict. Spread % and mid-market rate are never returned in the public response. Input { "amount": 10000, "currency_from": "USD", "currency_to": "EUR", "bank_rate": 0.9123, "date": "2026-05-13" } Output (opaque public response) { "score": 7, "color": "yellow", "verdict": "Fair FX pricing", "currency_pair": "USD/EUR", "amount": 10000, "date": "2026-05-13", "encouragement": null } Rate limit: 10 audits / day per API key (free). full_forensic_fx_report Paid tier ($199) Full forensic audit including spread breakdown, projected loss, and partner routing intelligence. Requires a paid Bearer token. Input { "audit_id": "uuid", "include_routing": true } Output (opaque public response) { "audit_id": "uuid", "score": 4, "color": "orange", "verdict": "FX pricing above market expectations", "spread_pct": 2.21, "mid_market_rate": 0.9241, "projected_annual_loss_usd": 184500, "recommended_partner": "ebury" } Rate limit: Unlimited on paid tier; priority routing. check_fx_mid_market_rate Free tier Fetch the live mid-market reference rate for a currency pair. Returns both directions to help detect inverted quotes. Input { "base": "USD", "quote": "EUR" } Output (opaque public response) { "pair": "USD/EUR", "mid_market_rate": 0.9241, "inverted_pair": "EUR/USD", "inverted_mid_rate": 1.0821, "as_of": "2026-05-13T12:00:00Z" } Rate limit: 60 calls / minute per API key. 3. Authentication Method: HTTP Bearer token in Authorization header. Format: ipx_live_xxxxx (production) or ipx_test_xxxxx (sandbox). How to get a key: Open your iPayX dashboard → API keys . Authorization: Bearer ipx_live_xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx Content-Type: application/json Accept: application/json, text/event-stream 4. Compatible MCP Clients Claude Desktop / Claude.ai ChatGPT (via OpenAI Apps SDK) Microsoft Azure Foundry Agents — setup guide Cursor / Continue / Cline Lovable Agent 5. Rate Limits & SLA Free tier: 10 audits / day per API key. Paid tier ($199): unlimited audits, priority routing. SLA: 99.5% uptime, response time < 2s p95.
